name: adhd-off-my-plate
description: ADHD: Off My Plate. A chief of staff for one ADHD brain: brain dump, to-do list, inbox, calendar, and unfinished projects in; one Plate out. Plus straight talk: every reply opens with the thing to do and ends on one next step.

interface.shortDescription: A chief of staff for one ADHD brain
interface.longDescription: Hand it a messy brain dump, a to-do list that is too long, your inbox, and your calendar. It hands back one Plate: what it is taking off you, the 1 to 3 things that matter today, what to let go of, and a single next step. Straight talk shapes every other reply the same way: the thing to do first, steps numbered, one next step last.
defaultPrompt: Use straight-talk for the rest of this session.
Use plate-triage on this brain dump.
What am I missing this week?
